title: Landing page for agencies: add an AI-readiness audit to your services
why: Segment A has no GEO offer yet. A page that explains the audit in their terms and links to the scan and the Fix quote.
body:
INTENT: agencies of 1 to 30 people (SEO, content, digital) that do not sell GEO yet.

OUTLINE: H1 "Add an AI-readiness audit to what you sell"; what the free scan reads (16 checks, 10 crawlers); what an audit deliverable looks like (the sample report of our own site, 28 pages, 4 Oct 2026); where Fix fits (technical layer, quote from $299, applied by hand) and what stays the agency's job; what we do not claim (readiness, not citations); one CTA: scan a client site free, then request a Fix quote. API and CLI mention only as live (npx citehound scan).

FACTS USED: all from CONTEXT.md truth table. No client names, no counts of customers, no claim of ties to other companies.

REASON: gives outreach and posts a page to land on; the funnel is scan, then quote.
